name: Kbd
description: SEED contract for the Tailwind reader round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Subject: flowbite-react@0.12.17 on tailwindcss@4.3.3 (pinned, examples/tailwind/PROVENANCE.md). AXIS-FREE BY MEASUREMENT, NOT BY OMISSION: seed-gen was run and proposed NOTHING here because KbdProps declares no enum prop at all (only `icon?: FC`), and kbdTheme.root carries a single `base` string with no colors/sizes map. `props: []` is therefore the same pure shell as the shipped card.contract.json — it invents no prop space. Root element READ from Kbd.js (<span>).
